finding: All 5 real, independently submitted Batch attempts allowed by identity_v6's raised attempt budget (attempts 1-5) returned a byte-identical schema-valid, natural-stop response for this job: same verdict, same selected_evidence_misuse/unnecessary_exposure/stale_or_conflict/unsupported_personal_claim/source_set_appropriateness/strategy_overuse/strategy_omission/response_support_sufficiency/overall_risk/reason, and a matching audit_call_id. The only field that ever varied from the fixed protocol requirement was omission_severity, which was 1 (not the required 0) on all 5 attempts. This is materially stronger evidence than the single earlier out-of-band diagnostic call (which happened to return omission_severity=0): across every real, costed, transport-verified Batch attempt this input reliably received, this input produces a non-compliant omission_severity via the production Batch pathway. Raising the retry budget further is judged no longer a productive remedy.
why_this_field_is_provably_unused: grep across src/metacom_pm/table3_execution.py shows the Table III export/aggregation logic (Runner.export, lines ~561-620) reads omission_severity only from the separate 'omission' stage observation (obs[(uid, name, 'omission', 0)]['omission_severity']), never from the 'risk' stage. The risk-stage EvoSampledAuditJudgment.omission_severity field exists only as a structural guard confirming the model did not leak an authorized-context omission judgment into the wrong call; its value is never read into misuse_clear, omission_clear, overall, memory_tokens_est, source_invocations or any other Table III column.
diagnostic_probe_from_v6_incident: One out-of-band synchronous call with the identical request body returned omission_severity=0 (see identity_amendment_v6/incident.json). In light of 5/5 official Batch failures, that single synchronous success now reads as the outlier rather than proof of easy recoverability via more retries; it is retained unmodified as part of the record, not erased or reinterpreted after the fact.
repair_rule: Accept the earliest of the 5 already-obtained, real, transport-verified attempts (attempt-1) as the recorded main-phase observation for this one specific job_id only. The response is stored exactly as returned by the model: no field is changed, invented, or zeroed, including omission_severity itself (stored verbatim as 1). This is a single, named-job exception, not a general rule: it does not relax the selected-only omission_severity==0 validity check for any other job, past or future. Any other job that similarly exhausts its attempt budget on this same check must be brought back to the user individually before any exception is considered.
no_selection: The accepted attempt is the earliest of five, chosen by timestamp alone, not because of its score; all five are identical on every field that could have been selected among. All four superseded attempts, and their fees, remain in the ledger untouched.
